# Hiran Maladenige, Product Engineer

> Product and R&D engineer in Kuopio, Finland. Takes products from requirements to working prototype: mechanical design, system integration, electronics, testing, drawings, costing and risk analysis. Certified SOLIDWORKS Professional (CSWP). Available for full-time work.

## Summary of output
- 13 products and devices designed, including a 10-product range as lead 3D design engineer at Sportdog.lv (2022)
- 300+ CAD parts and assemblies modelled; 50+ engineering drawings produced
- Certified SOLIDWORKS Professional (CSWP, 2020, ID C-GDLRE69AFY) and Associate (CSWA, 2018, ID C-A3RPKRSD38)

## Selected projects
- Multi-laser light source for an atomic force microscope (2021–2022): sole engineer; over 100 parts; system integration of mechanics, optics, electronics and firmware; custom Altium PCB; 12-sheet A1 drawing set; mould and CNC plans; risk analysis; €486 BOM
- Dog-collar QR tag product range, Sportdog.lv (2022): 10 products; SOLIDWORKS, FEA, production drawings, prototypes
- Surgical operating table, tabletop subsystem (2021): 20 specification parameters, actuator sizing, 550 kg FEA load cases, ISO 14971
- Motorised fibre positioner for an AFM (2022): 32-body mechanism, 0.025 mm linear step
- CNC parts for a laser aiming fixture (2021): machining route, G-code, CMM plan for ±0.05 mm
- ADDI radiotherapy plan evaluation software (2024–2026), Kuopio University Hospital
